dataset.title: GEOFON Seismic Network: GE.MATE..BHZ recorded waveform

GE.MATE.BHZ.20160824.mseed.role: Unmodified archive response; includes complete MiniSEED records outside requested interval

units.latitude_longitude: degrees, WGS84 default for the absent StationXML datum attribute; no projected CRS inferred
units.station_elevation: 494 m above sea level per StationXML

missing_values: No gaps or masked samples in this interval. Never fill gaps or extend beyond observed data.
processing: Preserve all 6047 server-returned integer samples, start 2016-08-24T01:34:57.895Z.
For a contained window, retain actual sample times; requested round-second boundaries are not relabelled as existing samples.
Apply ObsPy full response deconvolution to velocity, fixed prefilter (0.05,0.1,4,5) Hz, no water-level clipping, mean removal and 5% cosine taper.
uncertainty: Source does not supply a complete amplitude/timing error model. Sample phase and sampling interval are known; PSD/RMS are not confidence intervals.
limitations: StationXML Created timestamp and archive metadata can change on a new query: hashes identify this vendored snapshot, not an immutable FDSN service revision.
No event catalogue, arrival labels, source inversion, or physical interpretation is validated.
Instrument-corrected output is band limited; endpoint and out-of-band ground motion are excluded.
